phrases.latin: Per fenestellam arborēs tam propinquae praeterībant ut eās paene tangere possēs.
phrases.english: Through the window the trees went by so close you could almost touch them.
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 219, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.
